svg.title: Guild Queue — bottom tabs, Dungeons page
svg.desc: Two bottom navigation tabs, Dungeons followed by Quests. Dungeons contains the queue and its filters; Quests uses the whole page for same-zone guildmates and shared quests. Illustrative data, not an in-game capture.
